I changed the year combo so it always includes the year already saved on the record. Nothing was run or tested, apart from a Ruby syntax check on `class_schedules_helper.rb`.

- **Include the saved year:** `YearSemester.selectable_years` (`app/models/year_semester.rb`) now accepts an optional year. If that year is outside the normal range, it is added and the list is sorted. The newest-first order still applies when `year_semester_range` asks for it.
- **Edit forms:** I added `year_form_column` to `enrollment_holds_helper.rb` and `class_schedules_helper.rb`. I also updated the existing one in `course_classes_helper.rb`. Each passes the record's year, so an older year shows as selected when you edit.

**Not done:** the issue doesn't say which screens are affected, so I covered the three that use `selectable_years` in a form: enrollment holds, class schedules and course classes. I did not change the range itself. The default is still 5 years back, set by the `year_semester_range` custom variable, so older years can be picked only if an admin widens that variable. The search filter in `enrollment_request_search_concern.rb` also still uses the plain range.
